entities.name: Jodah

entities.name: Coalition

events.summary: Jodah travels to Yavimaya to ask for the elves' support against the Second Phyrexian Invasion.
events.quote: Jodah the Eternal traveled to Yavimaya to ask for the elves' support

events.summary: Rona attacks Yavimaya in a dragon engine; Jodah and Meria defeat it with a Thran Damping Sphere.
events.quote: Only the concerted efforts of Jonah and Meria, and their use of an old Thran Damping Sphere made it possible to defeat the Dragon Engine.

events.summary: Meria pledges her people to the Coalition and leads Yavimayan forces at the Battle of the Mana Rig.
